configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server shown publicly

configurationFields.label: Server Shortname
configurationFields.description: Sets the shortname of the server shown publicly

configurationFields.label: Server Admin Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server admin shown publicly

configurationFields.label: Welcome Message
configurationFields.description: Player welcome message (MOTD)

configurationFields.label: Make Server Public
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be registered to the master server and be publicly visible in the in-game browser

configurationFields.label: Server Behind NAT
configurationFields.description: Enable this setting if your server is on a NATed network, to ensure it shows the correct ping in the master server browser

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Password for players and spectators to connect to the server

configurationFields.label: Admin Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the server admin mode - either Standard (single admin user) or xAdmin (multiple admin users). xAdmin users must be configured in xAdmin.ini

configurationFields.label: Standard Admin Password
configurationFields.description: In-game and webserver admin password (for Standard admin mode)

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Maximum number of players that may connect to the server

configurationFields.label: Spectator Limit
configurationFields.description: Maximum number of spectators that may connect to the server

configurationFields.label: Map Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the map to load. The Game Type must match. If Custom is selected, the Custom Map Name must also be set

configurationFields.label: Custom Map Name
configurationFields.description: If Custom map is selected, sets the name of the map. The map file must be included in the Maps directory

configurationFields.label: Auto Rotate Maps
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server map will automatically rotate

configurationFields.label: Game Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the game type for the server. If Custom is selected, the Custom Game Type Name must also be set

configurationFields.label: Custom Game Type Name
configurationFields.description: If Custom game type is selected, sets the name of the game type

configurationFields.label: Mutators
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of mutators to enable on the server

configurationFields.label: Redirection URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL for a redirection website for clients to download required files. The URL must end in a slash

configurationFields.label: Enable Webserver
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server's webserver will operate

configurationFields.label: Gore Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the level of gore displayed in-game

configurationFields.label: Mute Spectators
configurationFields.description: If enabled, spectators will be muted (cannot chat during the game)

configurationFields.label: Kick Idle Players
configurationFields.description: If enabled, idle players will be kicked after the set interval. 0 = no idle kicking

configurationFields.label: Minimum Players
configurationFields.description: Minimum number of players for all standard game types. Vacant slots will be filled with bots, unless bots are disabled. 0 = no minimum

configurationFields.label: Disable Bots
configurationFields.description: If enabled, bots will not join the server

configurationFields.label: Bot Difficulty Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level of bots on the server

configurationFields.label: Assault: Player Wait Period
configurationFields.description: Sets how long to wait for players before spawning bots for the Assault standard game type. 0 = start the game immediately

configurationFields.label: Assault: Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the game time limit for the Assault standard game type. 0 = no time limit

configurationFields.label: Assault: Round Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of pairs of rounds a game lasts for the Assault standard game type

configurationFields.label: Assault: Round Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period a round lasts for the Assault standard game type

configurationFields.label: Assault: Practice Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period the practice round lasts for the Assault standard game type

configurationFields.label: Bombing Run: Player Wait Period

configurationFields.label: Bombing Run: Score Limit

configurationFields.label: Bombing Run: Time Limit

deploymentSteps.name: Server Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; cd .; Remove-Item srv -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; $DownloadUrl = 'https://github.com/IceOfWraith/UT2004.git'; $Branch = 'oldunreal'; if (-Not (Test-Path .git)) { Write-Output \"Installing the server\"; git clone -b $Branch --single-branch \"$DownloadUrl\" srv 1> $null; Copy-Item srv/* ./ -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Remove-Item srv -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Server installed\" } } else { Write-Output \"Updating the server\"; git fetch origin $Branch *> $null; git checkout $Branch --force *> $null; git pull 1> $null; @('Manual', 'Web_Default', 'Win32_Serverstart_GUI') | ForEach-Object { $dir = \"$_\"; if (Test-Path $dir) { Remove-Item $dir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Output \"Server updated\" }"

deploymentSteps.name: Show Update Instructions
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "if grep -qx \"ServerActors=IpDrv.MasterServerUplink\" System/UT2004.ini; then echo \"Warning: Server configuration outdated. Please update System/UT2004.ini according to these instructions: https://github.com/OldUnreal/UT2004Patches?tab=readme-ov-file#updating-existing-server-installations\"; fi"

deploymentSteps.name: Show Update Instructions
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "if (Select-String -Path System/UT2004.ini -SimpleMatch 'ServerActors=IpDrv.MasterServerUplink' -Quiet) { Write-Output 'Warning: Server configuration outdated. Please update System/UT2004.ini according to these instructions: https://github.com/OldUnreal/UT2004Patches?tab=readme-ov-file#updating-existing-server-installations' }"
